arxiv-2201-02288.title: Formation of probability density waves and probability current density waves by excitation and decay of a doublet of quasistationary states of a three-barrier heterostructure upon scattering of gaussian wave packets
arxiv-2201-02288.creator: Yu. G. Peisakhovich, A. A. Shtygashev
arxiv-2201-02288.description: Abstract Annotation. A numerical-analytical simulation of scattering by a three-barrier heterostructure of an electronic Gaussian wave packet, the spectral width of which is on the order of the distance between the levels of the doublet of quasi-stationary states, is carried out.

arxiv-2208-03116.title: Influence of errors on the transport of quantum information through distant quantum dot spin qubits
arxiv-2208-03116.creator: Iann Cunha, Leonardo Kleber Castelano
arxiv-2208-03116.description: Abstract The ability to connect distant qubits plays a fundamental role in quantum computing. Therefore, quantum systems candidates for quantum computation must be able to interact all their constituent qubits. Here, we model the quantum dot spin qubits by a spin chain with nearest-neighbors interaction.

arxiv-2210-12870.title: Imbalanced Class Data Performance Evaluation and Improvement using Novel Generative Adversarial Network-based Approach: SSG and GBO
arxiv-2210-12870.creator: Md Manjurul Ahsan, Md Shahin Ali, Zahed Siddique
arxiv-2210-12870.description: Abstract Class imbalance in a dataset is one of the major challenges that can significantly impact the performance of machine learning models resulting in biased predictions. Numerous techniques have been proposed to address class imbalanced problems, including, but not limited to, Oversampling, Undersampling, and cost-sensitive approaches.

arxiv-2302-07872.title: Data-Centric Governance
arxiv-2302-07872.creator: Sean McGregor, Jesse Hostetler
arxiv-2302-07872.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Sean McGregor, Jesse Hostetler. Artificial intelligence (AI) governance is the body of standards and practices used to ensure that AI systems are deployed responsibly. Current AI governance approaches consist mainly of manual review and documentation processes. While such reviews are necessary for many systems, they are not sufficient to systematically address all potential harms, as they do not operationalize governance requirements for system engineering, behavior, and outcomes in a way that facilitates rigorous and reproducible evaluation.

arxiv-2304-04633.title: Special Cosserat rods with rate-dependent evolving natural configurations
arxiv-2304-04633.creator: K. R. Rajagopal and C. Rodriguez
arxiv-2304-04633.description: Abstract . We present a nonlinear, geometrically exact, and thermodynamically consistent framework for modeling special Cosserat rods with evolving natural configurations. In contrast to the common usage of the point-wise Clausius-Duhem inequality to embody the Second Law of Thermodynamics, we enforce the strictly weaker form that the rate of total entropy production is non-decreasing.

Simple SummaryDeprivation indices (DIs), constructed from area-level socio-economic indicators, allow to assess the acknowledged relationship between socio-economic status and health outcomes. Their role in adjusting for deprivation has not been evaluated within a mediation analysis of ovarian cancer survival.

pmc-11340087.creator: Yupiao Feng, Xinting Hu, Xin Wang
pmc-11340087.description: Targeted therapies, such as small molecule kinase inhibitors, have made significant progress in the treatment of hematologic malignancies by directly modulating protein activity. However, issues such as drug toxicity, drug resistance due to target mutations, and the absence of key active sites limit the therapeutic efficacy of these drugs.

pmc-11656933.title: Outcomes of definitive radiotherapy vs. laryngectomy followed by adjuvant radiotherapy in patients with locally advanced laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma: real-world experience in a referral cancer center
pmc-11656933.creator: Ali Kazemian, Ebrahim Esmati, Reza Ghalehtaki, Borna Farazmand, Nima Mousavi-Darzikolaee, Reyhaneh Bayani, Mahdieh Razmkhah, Maryam Taherioun, Niloufar Saeedi, Farrokh Heidari, Kaveh Zakeri

Surgical treatment can impair patients’ voice and swallowing function, making definitive radiotherapy a viable alternative for locally advanced cases.MethodsTo compare the outcomes of definitive versus adjuvant radiotherapy in patients with primary locally advanced laryngeal cancer, we retrospectively evaluated consecutive patients treated from 2007 to 2020.

pmc-12581508.title: Psychometric properties of the Chinese version of the attitude and confidence with oral healthcare among nursing students (ACORN) scale: a cross-sectional study
pmc-12581508.creator: Xuancheng Chen, Yangyi Chen, Yuhuan Xie, Xuejiao Zhu, Linan Cheng
pmc-12581508.description: BackgroundNursing students’ attitudes and confidence in oral healthcare are essential for service improvement. While the Attitude and Confidence with Oral Healthcare among Nursing Students (ACORN) scale is a validated assessment tool, its reliability and validity in China remain unverified. This study aims to translate the ACORN scale into Chinese and evaluate its validity and reliability among nursing students.

pmc-12735651.title: Peptides from General By-Products: Unveiling Their Potential Biological Activities in Human Health
pmc-12735651.creator: Alejandra Colón-Sandoval, Laura A. Contreras-Angulo, Luis A. Cabanillas-Bojórquez, Erick Paul Gutiérrez-Grijalva, Josefina León-Félix, Nayely Leyva-López, Leticia Xochitl López-Martínez, Miriam D. García-Cebreros, José Basilio Heredia
pmc-12735651.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Peptides are short amino acid chains that can be released from proteins through hydrolysis or fermentation, exhibiting various biological activities, including antioxidant, antihypertensive, anti-inflammatory, and anticancer effects. Generally, these compounds are extracted from food products. However, to maximize resource utilization under the premise of sustainability in favor of a circular economy, there is an interesting approach to obtaining peptides from sub-utilized parts and non-food products of food production and processing, based on the grade at which they can be valued.

pmc-13265960.title: Accurate prediction of ecDNA in interphase cancer cells using deep neural networks
pmc-13265960.creator: Gino Prasad, Utkrisht Rajkumar, Ellis J Curtis, Ivy Tsz-Lo Wong, Xiaowei Yan, Shu Zhang, Lotte Brückner, Kristen Turner, Julie Wiese, Justin Wahl, Homa Hemmati, Sihan Wu, Jessica Theissen, Matthias Fischer, Howard Y Chang, Anton G Henssen, Paul S Mischel, Vineet Bafna
pmc-13265960.description: Oncogene amplification is a key driver of cancer pathogenesis and is often mediated by extrachromosomal DNA (ecDNA). EcDNA amplifications are associated with increased pathogenicity of cancer and poorer outcomes for patients. EcDNA can be detected accurately using fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) when cells are arrested in metaphase.

pmc-13514284.title: Screening for Suspected Microplastic-like Particles in Post-Mortem Human Liver: Correlating Histopathological Alterations with Clinical Profiles
pmc-13514284.creator: Eugen-Toma Radu, Nastaca Alina Palade, Crina Cristina Solomon, Oana Gabriela Somcutian, Manuela Pia Pumnea, Maria Totan, Claudia Maria Mihuț, Cecilia Georgescu, Adina Frum, Carmen Maximiliana Dobrea, Felicia Gabriela Gligor
pmc-13514284.description: Background/Objectives: Microplastics (MPs) are emerging environmental contaminants with potential implications for human health. Experimental studies suggest that MPs accumulate in the liver and promote inflammatory and fibrotic changes, but evidence from human tissues remains limited. This study investigated the presence of suspected MP-like particles in post-mortem human liver tissue and their associations with clinical, biochemical, hematological and histopathological parameters.
